principle: Definitions and source semantics precede numeric synthesis. Primary/official sources are preferred for material numbers; literature evidence is DOI-addressed; tool convenience layers are not canonical provenance.

sources.title: Crossref database status / Stats
sources.limitations: Counts are Crossref metadata/DOI records, not a census of unique scholarly papers.

sources.title: Works Overview
sources.limitations: OpenAlex work types include more than journal papers; current counts are version-dependent.

sources.title: OpenAlex Corpus
sources.limitations: Expansion is noisier and excluded from the primary bibliometric denominator.

sources.title: Retraction Watch data in Crossref
sources.limitations: Retraction records are detected/corrected cases; expressions of concern and corrections have lower completeness.

sources.title: Retraction Watch data
sources.limitations: Raw snapshot is pinned by Git commit at execution time; project commits summary/provenance rather than redistributing raw input.

sources.title: Research Integrity in the Era of Metrics: Empirical Evidence from Meta-Analyses of Questionable Research Practices
sources.limitations: Researcher-level self-report prevalence; not article-level prevalence and never directly multiplied by publication counts.

sources.title: Prevalence of questionable research practices, research misconduct and their potential explanatory factors: A survey among academic researchers in The Netherlands
sources.limitations: Netherlands researcher population and three-year behavioral window; not article prevalence.

sources.title: Impact of retracted randomised controlled trials on meta-analyses and clinical practice guidelines: VITALITY Study I
sources.limitations: Randomized trials and clinical evidence ecosystem; English-language guideline search; not representative of all science.

sources.title: Guilt by association: How scientific misconduct harms prior collaborators
sources.limitations: Specific misconduct-case and collaborator sample; interpretation includes both stigma and rational updating mechanisms.

sources.title: Discontinuation and nonpublication of interventional clinical trials conducted in patients with mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer's disease
use: participant contribution without public knowledge benchmark
sources.limitations: E3 research-waste example in a disease-specific trial population; not evidence of fraud.

sources.title: Journal policies and editors’ opinions on peer review
sources.limitations: The 68.5M hours estimate is cited from Publons 2018 rather than newly estimated by this paper.

sources.title: Identifying sleeping beauties and their princes on a citation network
sources.limitations: Scopus-based historical corpus and operational SB definition; not evidence for ARIS4C005 counterfactual lost discoveries.

sources.title: Financial costs and personal consequences of research misconduct resulting in retracted publications
sources.limitations: Historical US/ORI/NIH context; not a global cost estimate.

sources.title: What difference do retractions make? An estimate of the epistemic impact of retractions on recent meta-analyses
sources.limitations: Preprint; supporting conceptual/methodological precedent rather than a final global estimate.

sources.title: NIH funding and the cost of retracted publications: a living analysis
sources.limitations: Preprint as of initialization; not peer-reviewed. Associated grant totals are not equivalent to waste.

sources.title: Citation Contamination by Paper Mill Articles in Systematic Reviews of the Life Sciences
sources.limitations: WoS life-science sample with database/top-relevance restrictions; only already retracted paper-mill articles; authors did not test whether each contaminated review's conclusions changed.

sources.title: Machine learning based screening of potential paper mill publications in cancer research: methodological and cross sectional study
sources.limitations: Cancer research only; training labels derive from known/retracted paper-mill cases; textual similarity is not proof of fraud; authors note potential geographic/language-pattern bias and incomplete representation of paper mills.

optional_tool_layers.scite: Available for discovery/full-text/citation-context work; tool outputs are not canonical source provenance when the underlying DOI/primary source is available.
optional_tool_layers.elicit: Attempted but current account lacks API access. Not a dependency.
optional_tool_layers.scite_collections: Creation attempted but requires paid access. Not a dependency.
